mathematical_scope: The 459-line module supplies finite-field primality/root search, exact Gaussian rank, monotone and balanced separation witnesses, tridiagonal solves and cut extraction, determinant polynomials, prime- and power-of-two Fourier cut certificates, a noncommutativity witness, and adversarial separation controls. For powers of two, reduction modulo X^(N/2)+1 is exactly the cyclotomic reduction. For prime N and determinant size at least 2, the coefficient sum at X=1 vanishes, so a nonzero reduced degree<N polynomial cannot be a nonzero multiple of Phi_N. Balanced separation preserves earlier separations by taking subsets and retains at least half of each color at every new order. The complex Fourier cut rank bound is rank(F[R,C])>=|R||C|/N, from Frobenius norm and operator norm of normalized Fourier submatrices. With m²>qN this excludes sums of q separated inverse-tridiagonal cuts, regardless of sampled Green coefficients.

mathematical_scope: Computes analytic l_p operator-norm upper bounds for a fixed-strength phase12 architecture. general bound 1+2/(1-d|alpha|delta) requires p in [1,2], delta=2/p-1 and d|alpha|delta<1. Path bound uses a stronger l1 Neumann bound interpolated with l2 unitarity. Combining path² and normalized I+i epsilon R yields K. A normalized Fourier matrix has l_p norm N^(1/p-1/2), giving t>=log(N^(1/p-1/2))/log K for products of these fixed stages and l_p-isometric interleavings. The helper does not prove the cited analytic interpolation/resolvent steps; they are assumptions/theoretical derivation, not numerical fitting.

mathematical_scope: Necessary two-stage invariant: if A=S2 Q P S1 satisfies AZ=DA, then Q P (S1 Z S1^-1) P^-1 Q^-1=S2^-1 D S2. Diagonal similarity leaves diagonal entries unchanged, and permutation similarity permutes them, so the diagonal multisets must match. A mismatch excludes every intermediate permutation and invertible diagonal for these fixed S1,S2 in the chosen field; equality is not sufficient. The two component formulas correctly compute diagonal entries of the conjugates.

cost_and_scaling: mats materializes N forward and inverse columns, O(N²) storage and O(N·apply_cost). Each diagonal computation uses N² products plus modular powers for modulation.
